title: A fitting place and welcome words
odia:
ଏମିତି ସଜରେ ବସି ଯାଇଥିବ
କେହି ନ କହିବେ ଉଠ୍
ଏମିତି ମଜାରେ କହି ଯାଉଥିବ
କେହି ନକହିବେ ଝୁଟ୍।
literal_meaning: Sit in such a manner that no one says, “Get up.” Speak so pleasantly that no one says, “False.”
meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କ ସହ ମିଶିବା ବେଳେ ବସିବାର ଢଙ୍ଗ ଓ କଥା କହିବାର ଭଙ୍ଗୀ ପ୍ରତି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦେବାର ଉପଦେଶ। ନିଜ ଉପସ୍ଥିତି ଯେପରି ଅଶୋଭନ ନହୁଏ ଓ ନିଜ କଥା ଯେପରି ଅବିଶ୍ୱାସ ନଜନ୍ମାଏ, ସେପରି ଆଚରଣ କରିବାକୁ କୁହାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The two pairs of lines ask the listener to avoid a rebuff: being told to leave a seat, or having a statement dismissed as false. Read as advice, they connect considerate conduct with speech that others can receive with confidence. The force lies in attending to how one’s presence and words affect others.
usage_example: Before joining a group discussion, a newcomer is advised to take a suitable place and speak thoughtfully, without exaggeration. The verse could frame that advice. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The short replies ଉଠ୍ and ଝୁଟ୍ give the advice its rhyme and its sharpness. One interrupts a person’s sitting; the other interrupts their speech. The balanced lines imagine conduct that gives no occasion for either rebuff.
